description: This file defines the interface for architecture-specific functions in the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, including context switching, hardware initialization, and reboot procedures.

methods.name: Os_ArchSetSpAndCall
methods.description: Sets the stack pointer and calls a specified function.

methods.name: Os_ArchSwapContext
methods.description: Swaps the current context with a new one.

methods.name: Os_ArchSwapContextTo
methods.description: Performs context swap for the first time for a task.

methods.name: Os_ArchSetupContext
methods.description: Prepares a PCB (Process Control Block) before use, setting up context markers and architecture-specific registers.

methods.name: Os_ArchInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware components like interrupt controllers and timers.

methods.name: Os_ArchFirstCall
methods.description: Handles the first call to a task entry, possibly switching to user mode.

methods.name: Os_ArchReboot
methods.description: Reboots the OS, either cold or warm reset.

methods.name: Os_ArchGetScSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the small context in bytes.

methods.name: Os_ArchSetTaskEntry
methods.description: Sets the entry point for a task.

methods.name: Os_ArchPanic
methods.description: Handles system panic with error code and frame pointers.
